posts.meta_description:
814K likes, 3,068 comments - rjkarishma on May 19, 2024: "Never in my wildest dreams did I imagine that I would walk the global red carpet at the Festival de Cannes, adorned in one of the finest creations by an Indian couture designer @abhinavmishra_ To top it off, I had the privilege of watching some of the best actors in the movie ‘Kinds of Kindness’—and honestly, who doesn’t adore Emma Stone? 

With the red carpet renowned for its fashion focus, I felt a deep desire to showcase our Indian culture and craftsmanship. Coming from the interiors of India, it was essential for me to bring a piece of our heritage to this global stage. Collaborating with Abhinav Mishra, known for his signature handcrafted mirror-work, resulted in a unique custom ensemble that makes me feel truly special and grateful. I absolutely loved this heritage creation and cannot express how blessed I feel to have this platform and opportunity.

Styled by @ayeshaaminnigam with @mehullsinglla 
Custom Outfit by @abhinavmishra_ 
Earrings by @aadiyajewels 
Rings by @mozaati @aadiyajewels 
Photographer @shakeelbinafzal".
